# mgc_object_storage_object (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an object storage object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mgc_object_storage_object" "object" {
  bucket = mgc_object_storage_buckets.my_bucket.bucket
  key    = "path/to/file.txt"
}

output "object" {
  value = data.mgc_object_storage_object.object
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Name of the bucket.
- `key` (String) The name of the object (key) in the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `content_type` (String) Content type of the object (MIME type).
- `etag` (String) ETag of the object.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified date of the object.
- `lock_status` (Boolean) Whether object lock is enabled for this object.
- `size` (Number) Size of the object in bytes.
